detail:
MEMO — Emily Prime to Emily Prime.

Most recent FatBaby observation (2026-06-11T00:54:39Z):
  'emily os mobility edition bare metal exokernel ISO2424242'

This observation is uncurated — it has not been evaluated and added to EMILY/BACKLOG.md. It represents a new product initiative (EmilyOS as a bare-metal exokernel for mobile/embedded hardware) that must enter the golden backlog before it can be planned, resourced, or acted on.

SESSION FOCUS:
All FatBaby observations that carry product or system-level intent must eventually land in the golden backlog. Today there is no instrumented pipeline for this — curation is currently a manual act performed by Claude Code roleplaying as Emily Prime (see EMILY/signals/observations/2026-06-10T230827Z-emily-prime-infrastructure-gap.json). That must change.

Required instrumentation:
1. CLI path: `emily backlog curate [--all]` — reads uncurated obs files, appends [ ] items to BACKLOG.md, commits, posts curation Apple, writes cursor to EMILY/var/backlog-curated.txt.
2. Emily Prime autonomous path: during triage, when an observation has novel product/system content (severity: info, no existing backlog match), Emily Prime invokes emily_write_file to append to BACKLOG.md and commits the change.
3. State tracking: EMILY/var/backlog-curated.txt — parallel to fatbaby-synced.txt — tracks which obs timestamps have been curated.

This requirement has been added to EMILY/BACKLOG.md as Section 13, item 1. The EmilyOS observation has been added as item 2 (pending curation pipeline).

ACTION: Implement Section 13 item 1 (curation pipeline CLI) as the first task of this session.
